about.divider_text: Before you see the code, know who coded it.

resume.summary: Full Stack Developer experienced in building scalable applications, microservices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS). Practical expertise in NestJS, Next.js, Node.js, Clean Architecture, DDD, CI/CD pipelines, and modern Agentic Coding & Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows with LLMs.

responsibilities: Architected and developed a central IAM platform with Single Sign-On (SSO), multi-tenancy, and RBAC.
Engineered microservices in NestJS and PostgreSQL integrated with Next.js interfaces, sharing packages via Turborepo and GitHub Packages.
Implemented Agentic Coding and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows with LLMs, governing autonomous agents for automation and fast software delivery.
Structured CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and managed continuous deployment routines on AWS.
Built data integration pipelines for processing files (XML, CSV, tax layouts SPED) and webhooks integration with enterprise ERPs.
Implemented unified cloud storage gateway with AWS S3 and Cloudflare R2, plus automated test suites using Vitest.
Developed and maintained critical CRM features, ensuring 100% compatibility with legacy code and reducing regression risk.
Led Git repository organization and structured code reviews to improve code quality and maintainability.
Refactored legacy frontend modules (jQuery → ES6+), improving performance and maintainability.
Modernized UI architecture using SCSS and modular components.
Handled 30+ critical incidents daily, supporting enterprise clients with high availability needs.
Reduced MTTR by 20% via diagnostic and automation scripts (Bash/Linux).
Maintained CSAT above 95% when resolving complex network and fiber incidents.

items.name: BizzConnect — Multi-tenant Messaging SaaS (Authorial Project)
items.description: End-to-end design, architecture, and development of a SaaS platform for contact automation and multi-channel messaging.
highlights: Structured scalable backend with Node.js, Prisma ORM, and Clean Architecture for high maintainability.
Implemented robust security with JWT authentication, refresh tokens, and strict Zod data validation.
Built reactive frontend using React, Vite, and TypeScript with real-time WebSockets.
